projects.name: Bugesera International Airport
projects.description: Initial capacity: 7 million passengers annually. Expansion capacity: 14 million passengers annually. First phase expected to be completed between 2027 and 2028. The project includes a 3,750m runway, a 130,000 square metre terminal, and cargo facilities.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Hotels and serviced apartments, airport-worker housing, warehouses and cargo logistics, cold storage, retail and restaurants, conference facilities, transport and car-rental services, water and electricity infrastructure, construction materials supply
projects.source: MINECOFIN Budget Framework Paper, New Times, 2025

projects.name: Kigali Innovation City
projects.description: 61-hectare smart city project at Kigali Special Economic Zone. Will feature universities, office spaces, startup business incubators, and commercial buildings. Expected to create 50,000 jobs and generate $150 million in annual ICT exports.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Commercial office space, retail facilities, housing for workers, conference and event spaces, research and development facilities, ICT infrastructure, hospitality services

projects.name: Kigali Centralised Sewerage System
projects.description: Network of about 90 kilometres across the City of Kigali with a wastewater treatment plant capacity of 12,000 cubic metres per day. Being built by China Railway Construction Engineering Group. Expected completion in February 2026.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Pipe installation and supply, pumping stations, treatment plant equipment, labour and skilled workers, maintenance contracts

projects.name: Kigali Urban Transport Improvement (KUTI)
projects.description: Upgrading seven major junctions: Chez Lando, Gishushu, Gisozi, Nyabugogo, Rwandex, Sonatubes, and Kibagabaga. Implemented in partnership with the African Development Bank.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Road construction materials, engineering services, traffic management systems, pedestrian infrastructure, street lighting

projects.name: Ruzizi III Regional Hydropower Project
projects.description: 206 MW hydropower plant on the Ruzizi River. First privately financed hydropower project in sub-Saharan Africa to harness a regional river basin. Will supply electricity to over 300,000 residents across Rwanda, Burundi, and DRC. Construction expected to begin January 2026.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Construction materials and equipment, road infrastructure development, labour and skilled workers, local community resettlement and compensation, maintenance and operations

projects.name: Kigali Logistics Platform Connectivity Development
projects.description: Connectivity to the logistics platform at Masaka to expand traffic capacity. Will rehabilitate 69 kilometres of roads to link Masaka to Bugesera Industrial Park. Expected completion in 2030.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Road construction materials, logistics and warehousing facilities, transport services, industrial park development

projects.name: Nyabarongo Multi-Purpose Dam
projects.description: 59-metre-high dam with reservoir capacity of more than 800 million cubic metres. Will build a 43.5MW Nyabarongo II Hydropower Plant and irrigate 20,000 hectares. Expected to employ about 1,000 Rwandans during peak construction.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Construction materials and equipment, resettlement services, irrigation infrastructure, fishing and water transport services, agricultural development

projects.name: Nduba Modern Landfill
projects.description: Modern landfill facility covering more than 50 hectares. Will replace the existing open dumpsite which currently receives about 600 tonnes of waste per day.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Waste management equipment, fencing and site infrastructure, recycling and waste processing facilities, environmental monitoring systems

projects.name: Rusizi Port
projects.cost: Part of lake transport infrastructure push
projects.description: Port development on Lake Kivu to enhance regional trade and transport connectivity. Part of Rwanda's lake transport infrastructure push.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Port infrastructure, warehousing, customs facilities, trade logistics services

projects.name: Volcano Belt Water Supply System
projects.description: Phase 1 covers 178.9 km of pipeline with a 43,000 m³/day treatment plant. Providing clean water to three districts in the Northern Province.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Pipeline installation, water treatment plant equipment, labour and skilled workers, maintenance contracts

projects.name: Muhanga Industrial Zone
projects.description: Industrial zone development hosting A1 Iron & Steel plant and Golden Tree Mining (tantalum, lithium, niobium processing).
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Factory construction, machinery and equipment supply, logistics and transport, skilled labour, energy and water infrastructure

projects.name: Rwanda Mountain Ceramics
projects.description: Ceramic tile production facility using locally sourced clay. Creating jobs and reducing import dependency for construction materials.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Raw material supply, logistics and transport, facility expansion, equipment maintenance

projects.name: Kivu Belt Water Project
projects.description: Water supply project serving communities around Lake Kivu. 99% completion achieved.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Pipeline installation, maintenance, water treatment services

projects.name: Muhazi Water Supply Project
projects.description: Water supply project serving 543,000 people across Kayonza and Gatsibo districts.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Pipeline installation, water treatment plant equipment, labour and skilled workers, maintenance contracts

projects.name: Gishoma Peat Power Plant
projects.description: 70 MW peat-fired power plant using locally sourced peat. Provides sustainable energy to the national grid.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Peat mining and supply, plant maintenance, transmission infrastructure

projects.name: Hakan Peat Power Plant
projects.description: 70 MW peat-fired power plant providing sustainable energy to the national grid.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Peat mining and supply, plant maintenance, transmission infrastructure

projects.name: Kivu Methane Gas Power Plant
projects.description: Power plant extracting methane gas from Lake Kivu to generate sustainable energy.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Gas extraction equipment, maintenance, transmission infrastructure

projects.name: Masaka Hospital
projects.description: 830+ bed hospital. The largest general and university teaching hospital in Rwanda.
projects.sub_asset_opportunities: Medical equipment supply, construction materials, skilled labour, hospital furniture and fixtures
